prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one review-only concept sheet for ClanSync personal achievement emblems.
Primary request: Design ten original premium hard-enamel collectible gaming pins in ONE cohesive comparison board, two rows of five. These are a first design proposal for a personal emblem redesign, not production assets.
Input images: the two supplied images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY for polished gold metal, ivory/emerald/mint hard enamel, raised partitions, restrained realism, and friendly fantasy collectibles. Do not copy their flag or tree subjects.
Scene/backdrop: uniform warm off-white background, no scenery. Clean gallery spacing, exactly 2 rows x 5 columns. Large pins, equal optical size, enough negative space to see silhouettes.
Style/medium: beautifully crafted physical collectible hard-enamel metal objects, straight-on front views. Rich raised polished champagne gold edges, colored enamel inlays, soft upper-left studio highlights, crisp clean contours, moderate material depth. Broad shapes that read at 64px, not flat icons. Consistent family.
Top row is competitive AWARDS, each a finished rank-one design: medals with a short ivory/emerald ribbon crest and compact heraldic body. Left to right:
01 victory / win-rate: a faceted central five-point champion star within an elegant cup silhouette and two restrained laurel branches, emerald body, ivory enamel.
02 participation: a radiant sun inside a decorative calendar-like shield with three substantial notch marks at the top, NOT writing, ivory/emerald body.
03 appearances / most played: two upright crossed swords over a compact diamond shield, strong ivory blades and emerald inlay.
04 longest win streak: a rising phoenix formed by one bright flame and two symmetric swept wings, ivory/emerald flames bounded by gold.
05 prediction: a prominent four-point compass star with a small faceted central emerald, circular shield body, few crisp compass details.
Bottom row is PERSONAL MILESTONES, free-form pins without ribbon crests, a middle growth stage in each:
06 sessions attended: a gold winding path with three broad ivory stepping stones reaching a small emerald horizon arch.
07 matches played: an ivory sword and emerald shield backed by three gold fan-like metal plates, compact asymmetry.
08 cumulative wins: a cluster of three rising faceted emerald crystals on an ivory rock base with a small gold victory star.
09 personal best streak: one sculptural upright flame built from three bold enamel tongues, gold/emerald/ivory, clearly different from winged phoenix above.
10 correct predictions: an elegant emerald astronomical lens or compass ring surrounding a sharp ivory four-point sight star, compact standalone silhouette.
Layout text: put ONLY small neat charcoal two-digit labels 01 02 03 04 05 centered BELOW the top five pins, and 06 07 08 09 10 centered BELOW the bottom five pins. No title, no other words. Labels must be separate from the pins.
Constraints: exactly ten different concepts in specified order; no literal game trademarks; no real-world military insignia; no numbers or text inside any pin; no UI buttons or cards; no fake transparency checkerboard; no giant drop shadows; no busy filigree, no tiny decorative filler; no copies of the reference flag or tree.
